resources.string: No pending request. Requests dispatched from the PC appear here.
The phone never dials by itself. Tap Dial to place this call now, or Decline.
HANG UP NOW with the Phone app – the PC cancelled this call (%1$s) and this app is not the default dialer.
Emergency stop active – dialing blocked until the PC clears it

• A call.request is acknowledged only if CALL_PHONE is granted, the request is not expired, no emergency stop is active and no other job is pending.
• mode=autonomous is always refused with "autonomous mode not enabled on device".
• Every TelephonyCallback and InCallService state change is sent as call.state with the call_job_id.
• call.cancel ends the call through InCallService when this app is the default dialer; otherwise you must hang up yourself.
Stops everything on this phone and on the PC
Emergency stop is active. Dialing stays blocked until the operator clears it on the PC (heartbeat_ack.emergency_stop_active = false).

1. Sends safety.emergency_stop (issued_by=android) to the PC, which cancels all call jobs.\n2. Ends the active call if this app is the default dialer; otherwise shows "Hang up now".\n3. Rejects any pending request and refuses new ones until the PC reports the stop cleared.
Fixed in this version. The phone never dials without a tap.

SELL AGENT Companion by FITRON. Uses only public Android APIs: TelecomManager, TelephonyCallback, InCallService (default-dialer role), AudioManager, foreground services. No call audio is captured or injected.
Emergency stop is active; dialing is blocked until the PC clears it.
Ending a call needs the default-dialer role. Otherwise hang up with the Samsung Phone app.
A call request is waiting for your tap
SELL AGENT Companion lets the Windows PC send call requests to this phone. You see each request and tap Dial yourself; the phone reports the call state back to the PC. Human-assisted only.
Dial places the oldest queued request: %1$s
While paused, new requests from the PC are refused (queue_paused).
Local history built from the call.state events this phone sent. Durations are measured on this phone.
Notes stay on this phone in this release; they are not sent to the PC.
Contacts are managed in the Windows app. Protocol 1.0 does not send contact lists to the phone, so nothing is shown here.
Campaigns are managed in the Windows app. Their calls arrive here as call requests in Calls › Queue.
